deciding.result_valid: The test ended a week before sched_end (05-13 against 05-20), though a cut test is dated. The recorded 44% exceeds 16/40 = 40% from the non-excluded replicates. Contamination is heavy but mitigated by exclusion and agar transfer. These signals pull both ways.
deciding.next_step: If the result is valid, 40-44% is far below the 85% threshold and calls for regeneration. The early end, summary mismatch and heavy contamination argue for a retest instead. The two are close.
deciding.shortfall_cause: In the non-excluded replicates, 17 of 24 non-germinated seeds are contaminated, with only 3 fresh and 4 dead. Contamination accounts for most losses.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Recorded 44% against 40% computed. The 4 points are 10% of the expected value, on the edge between levels 1 and 2.
deciding.germ_decline: The previous matching test was 56%. The fall is 12 points from the recorded 44% and 16 from the computed 40%, straddling the 15/16 edge between levels 1 and 2.
